ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a predominantly low-intensity black background (estimated 85% of surface) punctuated by high-intensity white specks and distal patches (estimated 15% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions are located at the extreme lateral distal tips of both lobes; high-frequency white punctate mottling is distributed across the entire medial and lateral surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged, irregular boundary across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-15 pixel diameter) distributed throughout the dark-pigmented regions of both lobes, suggesting dense barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white scarring and edge erosion visible on the terminal ends of both the left and right fluke lobes.
